name: Cardholder PAN + expiry in transit to PSP
rationale: PAN validity ~3-5y (card expiry/reissue). CVV excluded: seconds. Leaves cluster to the PSP over the internet.

name: Customer PII on orders (name; address; email)
rationale: Retention-driven (tax/consumer-law ~7-10y). Browser to ingress crosses the public internet.

name: Session IDs and cart contents
rationale: Expire in minutes-hours (~1h = 0.0001y). Control case: quantum leg must vanish.

name: Product catalogue
evidence_for_zeroing: Public marketing data; no confidentiality requirement (README: served from a JSON file)
rationale: Control case: both legs must vanish.

name: Cart store contents at rest (Redis)
rationale: Days of retention. Redis in-cluster. Plaintext by default so no quantum-vulnerable KEX; classical sniffing dominates.

name: Service-to-service mTLS identities (mesh certs)
rationale: Rotated ~quarterly (assumed). East-west only; collection needs in-cluster or node position.

name: Order-confirmation emails (PII + order contents) to SMTP
rationale: Mailbox retention outlives the order. Crosses to an external mail relay.

name: Long-retention order history archive (if added)
rationale: POSITED to exercise the class the demo lacks: regulatory retention, backup replication over partly exposed paths.
